Monitor daily product quality and share any product issues with the Supervisor.
Coordinate rotation checks, temperature controls, and identification of spoilage.
Organize items to match labels in slots.
Keep assigned cooler neat and organized and assist the team in conducting inventory.
Work with colleagues to check quality on in-house warehouse product and inspect coolers.
Clean, maintain, and sanitize all equipment used in the Quality Control area according to established sanitary rules, regulations, and maintenance/calibration procedures.
Support purchasing and sales staff by sharing accurate information on product condition.
Help ensure adherence to food security and food safety regulations and policies (HACCP, CGMPs).
Perform other tasks and duties as assigned by the supervisor/manager on duty.
cond_0441.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ability to work in cold environments (35–40 degrees)
One year of experience in Produce quality control
Ability to stand and walk for extended periods of time
Good understanding of quality, food safety, sanitation, and hygiene policies and procedures
Ability to lift 45–50 pounds
Capability to follow instructions and procedures and willingness to be trained
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of product quality and good hand dexterity and eye coordination
Basic cleaning of the assigned area: sweeping, dusting, and cleaning counters and scales
Strong communication and organizational skills
Strong attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to multi-task and manage time effectively
Good team working skills, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently when needed
Produce environment experience
The above job description is not an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties as assigned by their supervisor.
